text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
—If you don't even have the guts to gamble my life force,
what are you even doing, Festa?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Because... even without asking,
you already know the answer, right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Run in the race to show me, or run in the race to win...
...Those are your only two choices, after all.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: Then you've got to pick the one that gets your blood pumping... The one where you can have a real, all-out race.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
B-But if I do that,
Sensei will—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Festa.
Did you know that 'the desire to see an outcome' is just another name for 'hope'?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: I'll find hope on my own terms.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Watching the way you lived gave me hope.
...I looked up to you, someone who never stopped
striving for that single victory.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"What about your match?
What kind of victory do you envision?"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: That's......

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Even if that path leads straight to hell, I'll go with you."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...You guys are crazy.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
…………Once you make your choice,
there's no turning back, you know.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Nakayama-senpai... Are those registration documents for the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe in your hands, yes?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Trainer. El.
I have made up my mind.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: This is my choice.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
The ultimate form of victory I desire
is winning the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe
with Teacher still alive one year from now.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Unless every condition is met,
I will lose. The probability of winning
would be nearly 0%.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...That's why it gets the blood pumping, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then, the day of the Takarazuka Kinen arrived—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Today, it's my turn to show everyone
a special sight they've never seen before, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah!
Time to give it my all! Ohh-!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan is a very strong Umamusume, yes!
She knows the world, and shoulders the hopes of Japan!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Yeah... I know.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I might as well go savor the full weight
of being 'Japan's Supreme Commander.'

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"...Then the next time I see you,
you'll have grown even more, won't you?"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
When I hear the signal of your victory,
the condor shall take flight once more.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I know how it's done.
Alright, let's go, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: To the stage of my battle.
